hero.description: Home of the Mercer Chiefs — New Jersey's elite Tier II (NCDC) and Tier III (PREMIER) junior hockey organization. We develop student-athletes with direct pathways to NCAA Division III college hockey.

tryouts.title: Join The Chiefs Tradition
tryouts.subtitle: Evaluations for Tier I AAA and Tier II AA teams are held at Ice Land Arena in Hamilton, NJ. Experience elite coaching, high-tempo practices, and premier league competition.

tier1.title: Tier 1 National Bound & Youth
tier1.desc: Full-season Tier 1 AAA program competing in the Tier 1 Hockey Federation (THF). Includes 3+ ice sessions per week, professional skating coach Oktay Armgan, video analysis, and off-ice conditioning.
tier1.arena: Ice Land Skating Center — Hamilton, NJ
tier1.equipment: Custom CCM Chiefs gloves, pants, bag, jerseys

tier2.title: Tier II Competitive & Development
tier2.desc: Competitive travel hockey competing in the Atlantic Hockey Federation (AHF). Focused on continuous player skill acquisition, positional awareness, team culture, and positive character building.

camps.title: Camps & Clinics
camps.subtitle: High-intensity development camps designed for elite skating, puck mastery, shooting mechanics, and game-situation awareness.

items.title: Chiefs Pre-Season Elite Camp
items.desc: Daily 3 hours on-ice instruction, dryland conditioning, tactical video review, and power skating with Chiefs coaching staff.

items.title: Terry Jarkowsky Goaltender Intensive
items.desc: Specialized goalie mechanics, edge control, rebound management, and high-tempo situational drills.

arena.sectionSubtitle: The Mercer Chiefs train and compete at Ice Land Skating Center in Hamilton, NJ.
arena.title: Ice Land Skating Center
arena.desc: Flagship home ice of the Mercer Chiefs Tuition-Free NCDC Tier II Junior and USPHL Premier hockey teams. Featuring two NHL-regulation ice sheets, dedicated team locker rooms, video theater, and comprehensive athlete training facilities.

rinks.name: Ice Land Skating Center
rinks.desc: Flagship home ice of the Mercer Chiefs Tuition-Free NCDC Tier II Junior and USPHL Premier hockey teams. Featuring two NHL-regulation ice sheets, dedicated team locker rooms, video theater, and comprehensive athlete training facilities.

arena.broadcastDesc: Never miss a moment of the action. Every Mercer Chiefs home and away game in the NCDC, USPHL Premier, and THF is broadcast in high-definition with live play-by-play, scoring overlays, and instant game replays.

pillars.title: Direct NCAA College Advancement
pillars.desc: Extensive NCAA Division I & Division III commitment network with regular scout attendance and personal advocacy from Head Coach Rob Broderick.

staff.name: Rob Broderick
staff.bio: Coach Broderick brings decades of elite coaching, development, and junior hockey scouting leadership. Under his leadership, the Chiefs reached the Dineen Cup Championship and have graduated dozens of players into NCAA Division I and Division III hockey programs.

staff.name: Sasha Firsov
staff.bio: Former professional forward with extensive European and North American playing experience. Specializes in forward skill development, tactical offensive systems, and individual video analysis.

staff.name: Terry Jarkowsky
staff.bio: Nationally recognized goaltending coach whose netminders consistently earn all-league honors and collegiate roster spots, including 2026 starting goaltenders Jack Scali and Louis-Charles Lapensee.

staff.name: Ryan Kosecki
staff.role: Head Scout & Director of Player Personnel
staff.bio: Leads national scouting operations across North America, identifying premier junior and college-bound talent for both the NCDC and USPHL Premier rosters.

staff.name: Heather O'Connell
staff.bio: Oversees club logistics, league compliance, billeting coordinator programs, tournament operations, and community partnerships at Ice Land.

staff.name: Oktay Armgan
staff.bio: Renowned power-skating and stickhandling specialist working with both junior players and youth tier programs to accelerate edge control and high-speed execution.

newsArticles.title: NCDC Player of the Week: Goaltender Honors After 42-Save Shutout
newsArticles.summary: Big congratulations to our Chiefs NCDC netminder for earning USPHL Defensive Player of the Week! A commanding 42-save performance kept the Chiefs atop the South Division standings. #ChiefsNation #NCDC #USPHL

newsArticles.title: Youth AAA: 14U Chiefs Go Undefeated 4-0 at THF Fall Showcase
newsArticles.summary: What a weekend for our 14U AAA boys! Four games, four statement victories at the Tier 1 Hockey Federation Fall Classic. Team defense allowed just 4 total goals all weekend behind stellar netminding. #ChiefsAAA #THF #YouthHockey

newsArticles.title: Premier Sweep! USPHL Squad Takes Back-to-Back Battles Over Rivals
newsArticles.summary: Six points on the weekend! Coach Firsov's Premier squad delivered a pair of disciplined, high-tempo victories at Ice Land to push their win streak to four games. Catch the boys back on home ice this Friday! #MercerChiefs #USPHLPremier

newsArticles.title: Inside the Chiefs Training Facility: Power Skating & Video Prep
newsArticles.summary: Behind the scenes at Ice Land: Skills Director Oktay Armgan putting our junior and youth athletes through high-tempo edge control drills, followed by tactical video breakdown in the Chiefs team theater. Discipline. Loyalty. Tradition. Excellence.

newsArticles.title: Alumni Spotlight: Chiefs Alum Nets Overtime Game Winner in NCAA D1
newsArticles.summary: Love seeing our former Chiefs thriving at the collegiate level! Former Mercer forward scores in dramatic 3v3 overtime to secure a big conference win. The developmental pathway works! #MercerToNCAA #ChiefsAlumni #NCAAHockey

newsArticles.title: Goalie Academy Focus: Terry Jarkowsky Clinic in Action at Ice Land
newsArticles.summary: Eyes on the puck! Terry Jarkowsky Goalie Academy in full session this week with our Tier 1 and Tier 2 goaltenders working on rebound tracking, crease depth, and lateral recovery. #MercerGoalies #IceLand #ChiefsNation

newsArticles.title: Mercer Premier Game Day vs Connecticut Jr. Rangers at Ice Land
newsArticles.summary: Our Mercer Premier team takes on the Connecticut Jr. Rangers today at Ice Land! Puck drop is set for 1:30 PM. Come out to Hamilton and support the Premier squad or follow along live on BlackBear TV.

newsArticles.title: Mercer NCDC Game Day vs P.A.L. Junior Islanders at Ice Land Arena
newsArticles.summary: Friday Game Day! Chiefs NCDC battle the P.A.L. Junior Islanders tonight at Ice Land Arena. Puck drop is scheduled for 5:30 PM EDT in Hamilton, NJ. Come cheer on the Chiefs in person or stream live on BlackBear TV.

newsArticles.title: Youth Highlights: Chiefs 13U Wins 3-2 Thriller Over NYC Hockey Club
newsArticles.summary: Highlights of the week! Chiefs 13U took home an exciting 3-2 victory against the NYC Hockey Club on Sunday. Owen Bertoli netted the clutch opening goal, assisted by Quinn Danjnowicz!

newsArticles.title: Youth Highlights: Chiefs 12U Takes 6-1 Win Over Flyers Elite
newsArticles.summary: Highlights of the week! Chiefs 12U earned a big 6-1 win over Flyers Elite on Sunday behind a game-winning goal from Gregg D'Antonio Jr, assisted by Oliver.

newsArticles.title: Official Team Store: New Champion & Carhartt Mercer Chiefs Gear Now Live
newsArticles.summary: Two brands every hockey family already knows, Carhartt and Champion, are now available in your Mercer Chiefs team store. Hoodies, winter beanies, outerwear, and player gear are now in stock at shopmercerchiefs.breakawaysports.net.

newsArticles.title: Mercer NCDC Wins Opening Game of Hitmen Classic (6-4 over CJR)
newsArticles.summary: Mercer NCDC opened the Hitmen Classic tournament at the Ice Vault with an exciting 6-4 victory over the Connecticut Jr. Rangers behind relentless offensive pressure and clutch goaltending.

newsArticles.title: Mercer Premier Shuts Out New Jersey Renegades 6-0 at Ice Land
newsArticles.summary: Mercer Premier improved their regular season record to 5-2 with an emphatic 6-0 shutout victory against the New Jersey Renegades on home ice at Ice Land Arena. Congratulations boys! Chiefs Hockey - Discipline. Loyalty. Tradition. Excellence.

newsArticles.title: USPHL Premier Squad Goes 3-1 at Hitmen Classic; Coach Firsov Praises Effort
newsArticles.summary: Congratulations to our USPHL Premier team who went 3-1 at the Hitmen Classic tournament with wins of 1-0, 2-0, and 6-1. Coach Sasha Firsov commended the group: 'It was a great weekend for our group, competing hard every shift.'
